original_draft:
Keep album and artist names consistent without overwriting correct track credits is easier when the process is clear before choosing an app.

Install TagWeaver:
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759609875
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.onnellab.tagweaver2
replacement_opening: Choose one verified album title, preserve each track's credited artist, and test edits on copies before updating your library.
